risks: None to participants; the risk is a reorganisation justified by confounded evidence.
data: Published data only; extraction forms shared.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: older adults with more chronic conditions and those living alone may gain most from continuity, while working-age patients may bear longer waits; the review extracts subgroup results by morbidity and reports waits.
effectiveness: Informs a network decision with severity-adjusted evidence.
partnerships: Network patient advisory group and practice managers.
rebPath: No research ethics review is needed for a review of published studies; the protocol is registered publicly and reviewers declare their role in the reorganisation decision.
summary: No ethics review needed; conflicts declared; equity by morbidity and waits.
